🎥🎬: Little Shop of Horrors (1986)

Seymour Krelborn is a shy florist working in a struggling flower shop on Skid Row, where business is barely surviving. Everything changes when he discovers a mysterious and unusual plant during a solar eclipse. Hoping to attract customers and impress his colleague Audrey, Seymour brings the strange plant into the shop and names it Audrey II.

But the plant has a disturbing secret: it survives by feeding on human blood. As Audrey II grows larger and more demanding, Seymour discovers that keeping his newfound success comes at an increasingly horrifying price. What begins with a few drops of blood soon turns into a dangerous cycle of desperation, murder, and manipulation.

With Audrey II developing a personality of its own and demanding more victims, Seymour must decide how far he is willing to go to achieve the life he has always wanted. Little Shop of Horrors is a dark musical comedy about ambition, temptation, and what happens when success comes with a monstrous price.

source_details.synopsis: Little Shop of Horrors is a 1986 American horror comedy musical film directed by Frank Oz. It is an adaptation of the off-Broadway 1982 musical by composer Alan Menken and writer Howard Ashman, which is itself an adaptation of the 1960 film The Little Shop of Horrors by screenwriter Charles B. Griffith and director Roger Corman. The film stars Rick Moranis, Ellen Greene, Vincent Gardenia, Steve Martin, Levi Stubbs as the voice of Audrey II, and introducing Tisha Campbell, Tichina Arnold, and Michelle Weeks in the film debuts as well as special appearances by Jim Belushi, John Candy, Christopher Guest, and Bill Murray.
